nodes.title: Serve the built app on port 8000 at 0.0.0.0
nodes.summary: The project is a Vite single-page app. Its only run scripts are the dev server and preview, and neither is configured to listen on port 8000 bound to 0.0.0.0. This goal adds a production serving setup that does, and keeps the app's behaviour unchanged. It needs no privileged mode, Docker socket or extra capabilities, and it stays within the 512m memory, 1 CPU and 256 process limits. Covers [fb_fe28f6cb-3fb1-4a12-86a9-619c4a0f8060].

nodes.title: Add a root Dockerfile that builds and runs the app
nodes.summary: The repository has no Dockerfile. This goal adds a working Dockerfile at the repository root that builds the image with the repository root as the build context. The image runs the production-built app and listens on port 8000 on 0.0.0.0. It adds a .dockerignore so the build context stays small. The image must build within the 600 second build timeout and run without privileged mode, the Docker socket or extra capabilities. Covers [fb_fe28f6cb-3fb1-4a12-86a9-619c4a0f8060].
